paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : WMT15 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for four different models, comparing their performance in simultaneous machine translation. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 6 with tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", also has a linear scale, ranging from 12 to 28 with tick labels at intervals of 2. The four lines represent different models: Consistency-CE (purple dashed line with circle markers), Inconsistency-CE (dark purple dashed line with square markers), Inconsistency-CE-MP (blue dashed line with square markers), and Consistency-Bi (red solid line with star markers). The Consistency-CE line starts at around 13 BLEU at an AL of -0.5, increases sharply to 20 BLEU at an AL of 1, and continues to rise steadily to approximately 26.5 BLEU at an AL of 7. The Inconsistency-CE line begins at around 19.5 BLEU at an AL of 1, increases to 25 BLEU at an AL of 3, and then rises to about 27 BLEU at an AL of 7. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line follows a similar trend to Inconsistency-CE, starting at around 20 BLEU at an AL of 1, reaching 25 BLEU at an AL of 3, and ending at approximately 27 BLEU at an AL of 7. The Consistency-Bi line starts at around 23 BLEU at an AL of -0.5, increases gradually to 26.5 BLEU at an AL of 3, and continues to rise to approximately 27.5 BLEU at an AL of 7.
